headline: Nicolas Schereré, windsurfista mundial
content: “Los títulos son consecuencia de mi afición por el deporte”  Windsurfer world champion says titles will continue while enjoying what you do. An interview by María Claudia Medina // Photo: Caris Os Michilot For Peruvian athlete Nicolas Schereré, four-time world champion in windsurfing, recognitions will keep coming as long as he enjoys doing it. The primary thing in this sport is teamwork. Investing in good boards, sails, and keels is crucial for performing well during navigation. One has to get wet many times and test every sail until finding the perfect combination allowing maximum speed. What goes through your mind right before competing? My dad knows better than anyone else not to talk to me because I enter a state of concentration where nobody gets my attention. I carefully review circuits or strategies. Have you ever competed against unfavorable wind conditions? The wind is something extraordinary since it could either work in your favor or against you. Its necessary to have different solution plans, constantly monitor conditions, and make optimal decisions. Ideally, being an athlete who performs positively under any condition would be great. Now already a quadruple champion, is there anything left to achieve? In reality, the titles come as a result of passion for sports. Enjoying getting back on water makes sense, and more accolades should follow provided the enthusiasm remains intact. Winning a title specifically in the slalom category—which tends to be more competitive—would also appeal greatly.

headline: LEADER OF APP PLACES PROPAGANDA IN UNIVERSITY BUILDING
content: Candidates under scrutiny for using universities resources for campaign purposes. Paz de la Barrā claims dirty war comes from \the gang of Alan Garcīla\. The candidate president of Alliance For Progress (APP), Cesar Acua, faces allegations over his supposed partisan promotion activities within the University Cesar Vallejo (UCV), which belongs to him during election campaigns. However, its noted that he isn’t alone facing such accusations. His brother, also a congressman named Richard Acua, has been distributing Christmas cakes across hospitals in La Libertad region. Additionally, there’s mention of another case involving congress member Jose Luna from Solidarity National party who uses funds improperly through institutions like TeleSup university, owned by himself, for political campaigning. According to legislation, educational establishments cannot utilize their assets for political and propagandistic ends. This misuse involves leveraging state subsidies provided tax-free according to constitutional provisions—approximately forty percent of these funds being used illicitly. In response to criticisms, Luis Ibērico, head of Congress and leader of APP, assures clarifications will follow regarding charges against Cesar Acua concerning improper usage of UC Valeria facilities for promotional endeavors.

headline: CASE AGAINST CESAR ACAOA CONTINUOUSLY DENOUNCED
content: The intention behind giving out mini-pastries was purely charitable, says Cesar Acua amidst criticism about alleged vote-buying practices where money exchanged hands for votes back in 2013. An investigation confirmed suspicions around subsidy-for-votes transactions. During elections held in January 2016, legislative measures were proposed to prevent further exploitation of academic institution finances towards funding parties and costly campaigns. Furthermore, similar issues arise with other politicians utilizing institutional platforms for self-promotion, notably highlighted in cases surrounding figures like Jose Luna whose publications prominently feature his achievements despite questionable financial backing sources.

headline: MINIPASTRIES DISTRIBUTED BY FOOTBALL TEAM AT POVERTY STRICKEN AREA
content: Around 200 miniature pastries featuring images of Congressman Richard Acua Nez were distributed among residents of El Milagro neighborhood located in Chiclayo city center. These items were handed out by members of the football team belonging to the Cesar Vallejo Educational Institution (UCV), wherein the politician serves as Vice-President. Despite assertions denying any political motives linked to this act, reports suggest requests made directly to the sports teams led to donations intended for community outreach initiatives rather than explicit campaign promotions.

headline: CARLOS ARANA CALLS FOR STRICT REGULATION ON POLITICAL USE OF EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES
content: Secretary of organization and mobilization for alliance between Apra-PCP, Carlos Arana demands removal of presidential hopeful Cesar Acuas imagery displayed publicly throughout campus advertising boards associated with UCV. He criticizes what seems akin to blatant advertisement funded indirectly by taxpayer-supported education budgets exempt from taxes yet utilized politically contrary to legal stipulations outlined by national law governing non-profit entities including schools. Such actions necessitate oversight potentially enforced by bodies like Electoral Jury alongside Office overseeing Elections ensuring compliance before upcoming April 2016 polls.
